# `silk/build/publish`

<!-- Generated by silk doc-reference. Do not edit by hand. -->

Copies completed build outputs without exposing partially written files.

Import as `Publish` with `import silk.build.publish as Publish`.

<a id="copy"></a>

## `copy`

```silk
pub effect fn copy(source: &Path, destination: &Path) -> () ! AtomicWriteError | FileError | OutOfMemoryError
? &mut Allocator | &mut FileSystem
```

Copies a completed file or directory tree. Files replace their destination atomically and
retain executable permissions on Unix; directories merge their completed files.
